name: Magic Jar

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a gem, crystal or reliquary worth 500+ GP

summary: Move your soul into a container and from there try to possess nearby Humanoids.
text: From the container you can take a Magic action to try to possess a Humanoid within 100 ft (Cha save resists); its soul is trapped in the container while you use its body. Destroying the container while a soul is in it has grave consequences.
